description: This file defines React components for displaying product information in an e-commerce front-end. It includes the 'ProductCard' component to render individual product details with image, title, description, price, and an 'Add to Cart' button, as well as a 'ProductGrid' component to layout multiple products in a responsive grid.

methods.name: ProductCard
methods.description: React functional component that displays individual product details, including image, title, description, price, and actions.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Helper function to return the product title, possibly highlighted based on search terms.

methods.name: renderDescription
methods.description: Helper function to return the product description, possibly highlighted based on search terms.

methods.name: ProductGrid
methods.description: React functional component that arranges multiple ProductCards in a responsive grid layout.
